email.subject: Ironside Group Auto Care: booking and reviews
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I looked at Ironside Group Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just calls the next shop, and there are no reviews showing, which makes people cross-checking Harbor Falls auto shops skip past you for a competitor with visible ratings. The homepage title is also weak and probably underselling you in search results.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd fix first and why. Worth a quick look?

Alex
